title: 2025 Annual Ridership Report
text:
2025 Annual Ridership Report (2026-03-10) · Summary
2025 was our busiest year so far. Riders took close to one hundred thousand trips, up from 71,000 in 2024. The summer months carried the year: see Figure 1 for the month by month numbers. Growth came mostly from students and from commuters crossing the river. The two stations near campus and downtown were the busiest, as Table 1 shows. Lansingburgh grew the fastest from a small base.

title: 2025 Annual Ridership Report
text:
2025 Annual Ridership Report (2026-03-10) · Operations
Every morning a rebalancing truck moves bikes from full stations to empty ones before the commute. Figure 2 shows the loop it drives. The route was changed in October 2025 after complaints that Lansingburgh was empty by 7 am.

2025 Annual Ridership Report (2026-03-10) · What we will do in 2026
Add e-bikes at the three busiest stations, open four stations in Albany, and keep the winter service running. Winter opening hours are on the flyer posted at every station.

title: Incident report IR-2026-031
text:
Incident report IR-2026-031 (2026-03-12) · Filed 12 March 2026 · Field operations
Where: Monument Square station, dock 7; When: 12 March 2026, 08:40; Reported by: A rider, through the app; Technician: Jamal Ortiz

title: Incident report IR-2026-031
text:
Incident report IR-2026-031 (2026-03-12) · What happened
The dock would not release bike 4471. The rider was charged for a ride they could not take. Jamal Ortiz found a worn locking pin. A replacement pin is on order, and dock 7 stays out of service until it is fitted.

Refund Policy (February 2024) (2024-02-01) · Faulty bikes
